title: A board write that cannot reach origin writes a worktree's card file in place, and it can ride a merge
notes: board-program.ts writeHere fallback: when the sync to origin fails, a card write from a worktree lands in the worktree's .dashboard/board/cards/, gets committed with the work and merged onto main with a stale column. Today 2 of ~8 board writes from the main checkout failed 'cannot fetch origin/main' and worked on retry, so the fallback is hit in practice. Retry the fetch before falling back, and keep a fallback write out of the branch's commits (or refuse it in a worktree). Split out of bcb5f09e / #321, 2026-11-17.
